description: This file defines the UserManager class, which manages user-related operations such as listing users, signing in/out, retrieving user details, signing up, updating user info, and fetching books associated with a user or users associated with a book within a library management system.

classes.name: UserManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing user operations such as authentication, retrieval, update, and associations with books within the library system.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the UserManager with a DAO object, setting up user, book, and DAO references.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all users.

methods.name: signin
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returning the user object if successful.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves user details by user ID.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Creates a new user with provided name, email, and password, returning the new user object or an 'already_exists' message.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user information including name, email, password, and bio based on user ID.

methods.name: getBooksList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of books associated with a user by user ID.

methods.name: getUsersByBook
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users associated with a specific book by book ID.
